latest_cos_commentary.headline: unPLUG is a small, venture-backed first-party ordering and guest CRM/loyalty platform serving named fast-casual and coffee brands, recently expanding into an AI-driven customer-activation partnership with a large multi-brand QSR franchisee (TFI/Tıkla Gelsin).
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes with Genius's loyalty_engagement and digital-ordering-adjacent capabilities by unifying branded web/app ordering, POS integration, guest data capture, and lifecycle marketing into one guest-facing layer.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Small funding base (reported ~$1.2M total) relative to its named client roster; the TFI/Tıkla Gelsin data-science partnership signals an effort to demonstrate enterprise-scale capability beyond its current customer size.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: If a prospect already uses a first-party ordering/CRM point solution alongside their POS, confirm whether it's unPLUG; its named customer list skews toward regional fast-casual and coffee/juice concepts rather than large national chains.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Performance metrics (e.g., '+68% first-party sales,' '+57% guest LTV') are vendor-reported without third-party audit. Funding and valuation figures come only from aggregator trackers, not a primary source.

verification_needed: confirm total funding raised via a primary press release (currently sourced from aggregators)
pricing model detail beyond 'outcome-aligned pricing' messaging
